monthly_definition: Original ratio-before-mean, complete calendar grid, pragmatic primary and strict sensitivity; no historical backfill or provider return splice
training: Expanding; at least36usable matured labels and ten observations per parameter, including intercept; labels must also have been delivered by issuance
issuance_gate: No forecast until exact identity/venue/basis gates and source-specific delivery-age limits are documented and the complete feature month actually received; do not infer first-of-month availability
delivery_age_limit_status: unresolved_preissuance_gate; determine from authorized source documentation before opening new cohort data, not from losses
immutable_predictions: Append-only issuance records locked before targets; never reconstruct after the fact. Preserve first received and revised input vintages separately
invalid_model_output: Record nonfinite/nonpositive ratio or support-invalid output as an issuance failure for that candidate, not a substituted model or zero prediction
evaluation: Primary Novo24-month anchor-versus-persistence MSE uses every own eligible issued origin, not an all-model intersection. Strict sensitivity separate; secondary paired common-model MSE plus native failures/coverage. No interim loss-driven changes; overlapping cohorts are dependent.
automation: None authorized or scheduled; manual authorized ingestion only
revision_reason: Preissuance revision after registered LH5: Novo state methods did not beat the terminal anchor on exposed history; make anchor versus persistence the primary prospective contrast, retaining every candidate and benchmark

primary_loss_contrast.eligibility_mask: All actually issued eligible primary anchor/persistence origins, independent of OLS/ridge/PPML fit or support failures

secondary_loss_contrasts: OLS, fixed ridge and positive mean versus terminal anchor
candidate_roster_policy: Exact frozen primary plus secondary sample IDs; readiness is horizon-specific. Short histories remain blocked until the fixed maturity/coverage/source gates pass. No post-outcome additions or substitutions.
secondary_common_model_mask: Supplementary intersection of successfully issued candidate/benchmark origins only; report all native coverage/failures and never use it to censor the primary anchor/persistence contrast
preissuance_peer_review_clarifications: Freeze explicit exact sample IDs instead of a descriptive roster
Conditional-model failures cannot remove primary anchor/persistence origins
